section Section1;
shared RunLogAnalyticsQuery = (query as text) as table => let
    Source = Json.Document(Web.Contents("https://api.loganalytics.io/v1/workspaces/${LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE_ID}/query", [Query=[query=query, timespan="P${LOOKBACK_DAYS}D", #"x-ms-app"="FabricTokenomicsDataflow", prefer="ai.response-thinning=true"], Timeout=#duration(0, 0, 4, 0)])),
    TypeMap = #table({"AnalyticsTypes", "Type"}, {{"string", Text.Type}, {"int", Int32.Type}, {"long", Int64.Type}, {"real", Double.Type}, {"timespan", Duration.Type}, {"datetime", DateTimeZone.Type}, {"bool", Logical.Type}, {"guid", Text.Type}, {"dynamic", Text.Type}}),
    DataTable = Source[tables]{0},
    Columns = Table.FromRecords(DataTable[columns]),
    ColumnsWithType = Table.Join(Columns, {"type"}, TypeMap, {"AnalyticsTypes"}),
    Rows = Table.FromRows(DataTable[rows], Columns[name]),
    Result = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Rows, Table.ToList(ColumnsWithType, each {_{0}, _{3}}))
in
    Result;
shared msft_token_consumption = RunLogAnalyticsQuery("ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(${LOOKBACK_DAYS}d) and TotalTokens > 0
| extend NormalizedModel=replace_regex(tostring(ModelName), @'-\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$', '')
| project id=strcat('msft-', hash_sha256(strcat(tostring(TimeGenerated), '|', tostring(CorrelationId)))), event_id=strcat('msft-', hash_sha256(strcat(tostring(TimeGenerated), '|', tostring(CorrelationId)))), event_ts=TimeGenerated, usage_date=startofday(TimeGenerated), ingested_at=now(), source_code='msft', account_id='azure', region='', request_id=tostring(CorrelationId), correlation_id=tostring(CorrelationId), model_family=NormalizedModel, model_name=NormalizedModel, model_version='', deployment_id=NormalizedModel, user_id_hash='unattributed', team_id='unassigned', department_id='unassigned', business_unit_id='unassigned', cost_center_id='unassigned', project_id='fabric-parts-shortages', application_id='apim', agent_id='', environment='customer', task_id='', task_type='inference', prompt_template_id='', request_count=long(1), input_tokens=tolong(PromptTokens), cached_input_tokens=long(0), cache_write_tokens=long(0), output_tokens=tolong(CompletionTokens), total_tokens=tolong(TotalTokens), context_window_tokens=long(0), tool_call_count=long(0), tool_success_count=long(0), retry_count=long(0), failure_count=long(0), latency_ms=long(0), status_code=long(200), is_stream=tobool(IsStreamCompletion), currency='USD', source_cost=real(0), tasks_completed=long(0), hours_saved=real(0), tickets_reduced=long(0), code_generated_lines=long(0), quality_score=real(0), prompt_char_count=long(0), is_anomaly_seed=false");
shared msft_platform_metric_5m = RunLogAnalyticsQuery("union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(event_ts:datetime, service:string, region:string, project_id:string, team_id:string, model_name:string, metric_name:string, metric_value:real, unit:string, capacity_limit:real)[]),
    (ApiManagementGatewayLogs
      | where TimeGenerated >= ago(${LOOKBACK_DAYS}d)
      | summarize metric_value=count() by event_ts=bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), region=tostring(Region), project_id='fabric-parts-shortages', team_id='unassigned'
      | extend service='azure-api-management', model_name='', metric_name='request_count', unit='requests', capacity_limit=real(null)
      | project event_ts, service, region, project_id, team_id, model_name, metric_name, metric_value=toreal(metric_value), unit, capacity_limit),
    (AppRequests
      | where TimeGenerated >= ago(${LOOKBACK_DAYS}d)
      | summarize metric_value=percentile(DurationMs, 95) by event_ts=bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), project_id='fabric-parts-shortages', team_id='unassigned'
      | extend service='obo-broker', region='', model_name='', metric_name='p95_latency_ms', unit='milliseconds', capacity_limit=real(null)
      | project event_ts, service, region, project_id, team_id, model_name, metric_name, metric_value=toreal(metric_value), unit, capacity_limit)");
